verdict.rationale: HumanLayer is an agent-orchestration and collaboration platform, not itself a coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server: the docs cover the macOS app, remote daemons, the CLI, workspace config and Jira/Slack/GitHub/Linear integrations, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.
